text: B, salicylaldehyde. This is the Reimer Tiemann reaction: dichlorocarbene attacks the ortho position and becomes an aldehyde group. Salicylic acid comes from Kolbe's reaction with carbon dioxide, or from carbon tetrachloride in place of chloroform.
